paragraphs.text: Nameless Race is an obsolete creature type for a species of humanoids from Dominaria . They appear very similar to humans but with a red flame-like marking on their face and a small patch of hair tied back into a ponytail.

Nameless Race originally debuted as a type in The Dark on Nameless Race . During the Grand Creature Type Update , the type was made obsolete, and the card received errata that left it without any creature subtype at all.
